notes: rule 11: the Imam Abu al-Hasan al-Rida is the addressee of the man from al-Tayyara and speaks and acts in the scene («اخرج عني لعنك الله»); he is not added as a link, and whether he is a source needs a ruling
«رجال الكشي» is the source title: left out
the saying is the account of Yunus b. Dhabyan, so he is the last link; the first «يونس» is a different man from Yunus b. Dhabyan and is not merged
